anti_false_pass_checks_performed: Prior-red-scenario reproduction: on the freshly seeded DB, the ORIGINAL (pre-amendment) FF-13 SQL predicate still returns exactly 1 row (the migration-115 default-read grant) — proving the offending data shape is still present and the green is due to the sanctioned carve-out, not to the data having changed; the AMENDED predicate returns 0 rows on the same data.

FF-RP-14 adversarial verification beyond the test itself: planted (in a rolled-back tx, direct SQL) a NULL-facet record-grant with a FULL non-sentinel scope (registry-level node) -> CAUGHT by the amended predicate, confirming the invariant kept its force against the exact hanging-grant shape T-0082 outlawed.

Carve-out precision probe (SQL NULL propagation): planted read+NULL-facet grants with (i) scope='{}' and (ii) the sentinel shape minus nodeId -> both ESCAPE the amended predicate (inner AND-chain evaluates to SQL NULL, NOT(NULL)=NULL, row excluded from WHERE), whereas the pre-amendment predicate caught them. Assessed severity: PRIVILEGE-INERT residual, not a blocker — (a) such partial-shape scopes cannot confer any access through the PDP (isNarrowerOrEqual finds no containment for a parent scope lacking nodeId/kind: no self-match, no root-rule match, no rowIndex-walk match), so no privilege-carrying hanging grant can hide behind the escape; (b) scope is jsonb NOT NULL by DDL (migration 008) and every platform writer (grants DAO, register.ts, all migrations) writes full scope shapes, so producing such a row requires a deliberate malformed direct-SQL write; (c) the ADR §10.2 contract SQL itself prescribes this exact predicate — the coder implemented the ratified design verbatim. Same class as reviewer nit R-3 (deliberately-constructed evasion outside the gate's threat model). Recorded as residual: a follow-up could tighten the carve-out to AND NOT COALESCE((...), false) to restore full tripwire coverage over malformed rows.
